Memetic Carrier Frame.description: A whole memetic-wikitext carrier: the doctype declaration, the four frame markers, the toml meta block, one ahu section and the content-hash line lares meme normalize mints

Memetic Doctype Declaration.description: The declaration line that names a file's dialect and its lar: address, which the finder reads in place of the path

Memetic Carrier Marker.description: One carrier frame marker, carrying the control code that names which of the four frame positions it holds

Memetic Meta Block.description: The toml meta block a carrier head carries: its title, its type and the uri-path the address derives from

Memetic Ahu Section.description: An ahu section, opened on its fragment and closed on the matching sigil so the body stands inside a named block

Memetic Kanawai.description: The kanawai firing, naming the reference a carrier holds its own terms against

Memetic Lares Aim.description: The lares aim firing that opens a turn, reading operator intent on the left and delegating to the bearing the node adopts

Memetic Lares Yield.description: The lares yield firing that closes a turn on one forward vector and hands initiative back

Memetic Set At Aim.description: The set firing that seeds the panel at a turn's open, carrying the ward last as the frame orders it
Memetic Set At Aim.body: <<~ set hud="aim" mode="${1|draft,build,seal,riff,sketch,jam,relate,talk-story,hold|}" mu="${2|*!,*?,_!,_?,_0,*0,?0,!0|}" stance="${3:philosopher}" aperture="${4:10}/${5|pulse,beat,measure,arc,theme|}" ooda-ha="${6:5}/${7|declare-aftermath,declare-glyphs,declare-attention,declare-intent,declare-consequence|}" drift-ward="${8:the pull this exchange carries}">>

Memetic Set At Yield.description: The set firing that reports the panel at a turn's close, carrying the ward first and sliding each gauge from target to actual
Memetic Set At Yield.body: <<~ set hud="yield" drift-ward="${1:the joint that breaks first on outside contact} · ↻ L-Prime" aperture="${2:10}/${3:measure} -> ${4:12}/${5:measure}" ooda-ha="closed ${6:1}↺">>

Memetic Oracle.description: The oracle firing, carrying the felt-spend, the scatter, the die face and a blind tail whose length matches the face

Memetic Stance.description: The stance firing, naming the standpoints the following content reads within

Memetic Mu Tool Carry.description: The mu firing, naming which of the five tools of Chapel Perilous the following span carries

Memetic Aperture.description: The aperture handoff, naming the attention range the following span reads at

Memetic Drift Ward.description: The drift-ward handoff, naming how far the content stands from anything outside its causal island
